SELECT origin, connection_id, scope_reference, product_name,
       version AS reported_version, association_state, association_reason,
       candidate_count, parent_receipt_ids, shared_installed_user,
       applicability, finished_at AS inventory_collected_at,
       receipt_id AS resource_receipt_id, device_receipt_id
FROM evidence_pipeline.current_native_resource_packages
ORDER BY origin, connection_id, product_name, receipt_id

SELECT origin, connection_id, scope_reference, product_name,
       version AS declared_version, facts->>'member_type' AS declared_member_type,
       facts->>'architecture' AS declared_architecture,
       facts->>'resource_id' AS declared_resource_id,
       facts->'is_stub' AS declared_stub,
       association_state, association_reason, candidate_count,
       package_receipt_ids, shared_installed_user, applicability,
       finished_at AS inventory_collected_at, bundle_receipt_id,
       receipt_id AS declaration_receipt_id, device_attempt_id
FROM evidence_pipeline.current_windows_bundle_members
ORDER BY origin, connection_id, product_name, receipt_id
